items.title_en: ChatGPT now knows what you do on other websites via ad collector
items.title_zh: ChatGPT 现在知道你在其他网站上的行为，来自广告收集器
items.summary_en: An ad-collection mechanism can feed signals into ChatGPT to infer users’ activity on other sites, heightening privacy concerns about data fusion across services. This underscores the need for robust privacy controls and transparent data practices in AI products.
items.summary_zh: 通过广告收集器收集的信号可被输入到 ChatGPT，用以推断用户在其他网站上的活动，显著提升跨服务数据融合的隐私风险。这凸显了在 AI 产品中加强隐私控制与数据透明性的必要性。

items.title_en: Samsung is expected to more than double output of its HBM4 and HBM4E DRAM
items.title_zh: 三星HBM4/HBM4E DRAM产量有望翻倍以上
items.summary_en: Samsung is reportedly set to more than double the output of its HBM4 and HBM4E DRAM next year to meet surging AI and data-center demand. The planned capacity ramp could help ease tight supply for high-bandwidth memory used in GPUs and accelerators, potentially impacting pricing and supply chains across hyperscalers.
items.summary_zh: 三星计划在来年把 HBM4 与 HBM4E DRAM 的产量大幅提升，超过现有水平的两倍，以满足 AI 与数据中心对高带宽内存的需求。这一扩产将缓解相关供需紧张，可能影响 GPU/加速器市场的定价与供应。

items.title_en: Pirate Face Rescues LLM Models from Deletion
items.title_zh: 海盗脸拯救 LLM 模型免于被删除
items.summary_en: Pirate Face reportedly salvaged several LLM models that were slated for deletion, illustrating how AI assets can disappear when hosts purge them. The move fuels debate about archiving, licensing, and who ultimately controls access to foundational AI resources.
items.summary_zh: 据称，海盗脸拯救了原本计划被删除的若干 LLM 模型，凸显在托管方清理时 AI 资产可能被抹去的问题。此举推动了关于归档、许可权以及谁掌控基础 AI 资源的讨论。

items.title_en: Qwen Image 2.1
items.title_zh: Qwen Image 2.1 版本
items.summary_en: Qwen Image 2.1 introduces improvements in image generation quality, safety, and control. The update expands multimodal capabilities and finer style prompts, making it more practical for developers and designers.
items.summary_zh: Qwen Image 2.1 在图像生成的质量、可控性与安全性方面有提升，输出更真实且稳定。此次更新扩展了多模态能力，并支持更细致的风格提示，适合需要高质量合成图像的开发者和设计师。

items.title_en: US Revokes Limits on Power Plants' Climate Pollution
items.title_zh: 美国取消对发电厂气候污染的限制
items.summary_en: The policy reversal loosens emissions limits for power plants, potentially increasing climate pollution. The move affects climate policy, regulation, and the pace at which cleaner energy and tech solutions can scale.
items.summary_zh: 政策取消了对发电厂气候污染的限制，可能导致更高的排放并影响环境监管。此举对气候科技、监管不确定性及清洁能源部署速度具有重要影响。

items.title_en: Singapore’s National Library Board offers micropayments to build reading habits
items.title_zh: 新加坡国家图书馆局推出微支付以培养阅读习惯
items.summary_en: Singapore's National Library Board is piloting micropayments to boost reading and reduce smartphone time. The program rewards reading activities with small payments, using behavioral prompts to build lasting reading habits; it also raises questions about cost, privacy, and scalability.
items.summary_zh: 新加坡国家图书馆局推出微支付计划，旨在通过小额奖励培养阅读习惯并减少成瘾性手机使用。该计划以阅读活动为激励对象，结合行为经济学原理，但也引发成本、隐私与可扩展性方面的讨论。

items.title_en: Sherline Tools Is Going Out of Business
items.title_zh: Sherline Tools 将停止经营
items.summary_en: Sherline Tools announced it is going out of business, ending USA production of its precision hobby tools. The closure reshapes the tooling ecosystem for hobbyists and small workshops, potentially pushing buyers toward overseas suppliers or alternatives.
items.summary_zh: Sherline Tools 宣布将停止经营，USA 产线告停，精密工量工具的爱好者与小型工作室的供应格局将被重新洗牌，市场可能转向海外供应商或其他替代品。

items.title_en: I am often wrong
items.title_zh: 我经常犯错
items.summary_en: A candid reflection on being wrong often, sharing lessons on testing assumptions, embracing uncertainty, and iterating based on feedback. The piece argues humility and disciplined experimentation improve product decisions.
items.summary_zh: 作者反思自己经常犯错，分享如何检验假设、接受不确定性、并基于反馈迭代。文章强调谦逊与有纪律的实验精神有助于提升产品决策和团队学习。

items.title_en: I turned Jev into a (lousy) chatbot
items.title_zh: 我把 Jev 系统改造成了一个（糟糕的）聊天机器人
items.summary_en: An account of turning the Jev system into a chatbot with disappointing results, illustrating the gap between theory and practice in building conversational AI. It spotlights data quality, alignment, and evaluation challenges that plague many hobbyist or lightweight chatbot efforts.
items.summary_zh: 作者记录了将 Jev 系统改造成聊天机器人的尝试，结果表现不佳且存在明显局限。文章强调在数据、对齐与安全性不足时构建对话式 AI 的实际陷阱，以及在现实场景中实现可用性所面临的挑战。

items.title_en: A Necessary History of the Oddest Letter: W
items.title_zh: 字母 W 的奇特历史：一段必要回顾
items.summary_en: The piece traces the history of W, from its double-U origins to modern typography, highlighting why it's unusually shaped and pronounced in many languages. It also shows how the letter's form and usage reflect shifts in writing, printing, and linguistic conventions.
items.summary_zh: 本文梳理了字母 W 的起源与演变，解释为何它在字母表中显得与众不同。内容涵盖从“双U”起源到现代排版、以及在不同语言中的使用变化，映射出书写与印刷史的演进。

items.title_en: Laya (OS Jev) on Mac M4 CoreML Offline (45 decisions per second)
items.title_zh: Laya（OS Jev）在 Mac M4 上离线运行，每秒 45 次决策
items.summary_en: A demonstration shows Laya running on Mac M4 offline via CoreML at about 45 inferences per second. This showcases strong on-device inference capabilities and the potential for latency-free AI apps that don’t need cloud connectivity.
items.summary_zh: 演示显示 Laya 在 Mac M4 上通过 CoreML 离线运行，约每秒执行 45 次推断，展现了强大的本地推理能力及无需云端连接的低延迟 AI 应用潜力。

items.title_en: Resident Evil 4 (GameCube) – complete byte-identical decompilation to C/C++
items.title_zh: Resident Evil 4（GameCube）完成字节级等效反编译为 C/C++
items.summary_en: A community project released a byte-identical decompilation of the GameCube version of Resident Evil 4 into C/C++, showcasing advances in reverse engineering and preservation. The work enables closer study, potential porting, and broader accessibility of classic games.
items.summary_zh: 一个社区项目实现了 GameCube 版《生化危机4》的字节级等效反编译为 C/C++，展示了反向工程与软件保全领域的进展。该工作为更深入研究与潜在移植提供了基础。

items.title_en: AI-generated posters don’t have to be horrible
items.title_zh: AI 生成的海报并非一定糟糕
items.summary_en: AI-generated posters can look sharp when you constrain prompts, apply design templates, and supervise the result. The piece argues that good prompts, typography, and a bit of human curation are enough to avoid cartoonish outcomes and produce professional visuals for events. This matters for marketing teams and small events relying on quick, cost-effective design.
items.summary_zh: AI 生成的海报如果结合明确的设计模板、排版和人工把关，也能达到专业水准。通过精心的提示和后期筛选，可以避免千篇一律或显得粗糙的视觉效果，适合需要快速、低成本设计的场景。

items.title_en: Why MCP Was Always a Bad Idea
items.title_zh: 为什么 MCP 一直是个坏主意
items.summary_en: The piece argues that the MCP pattern (a software architecture concept) creates tight coupling and brittle evolution, making it hard to scale or change systems over time. It analyzes historical failures and suggests safer alternatives and governance practices.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为 MCP 这一软件架构/模式自始至终就是一个不佳的选择，原因包括耦合过紧、演化困难与长期维护成本。通过历史案例分析，提出替代模式与治理建议，避免重蹈覆辙。

items.title_en: Prompts aren’t Real
items.title_zh: Prompts 并非真实
items.summary_en: Argues prompts are abstractions that don't constitute real knowledge; focuses on system design, data quality, and evaluation instead of chasing perfect prompts. Emphasizes building robust workflows and verification around AI outputs.
items.summary_zh: 文中主张 prompts 只是抽象输入，不能等同于真实知识，强调应该关注系统设计、数据质量与评估，而非追求完美的提示。提出构建健全工作流与验证的重要性。

items.title_en: Show HN: Radius – A Meetup.com Alternative
items.title_zh: Show HN：Radius——Meetup 的替代方案
items.summary_en: Radius positions itself as an alternative to Meetup, aiming to improve event discovery and community-building with a streamlined user experience. It could appeal to niche groups and developers seeking more control over their local meetups.
items.summary_zh: Radius 作为 Meetup 的替代方案，聚焦简洁的体验以提升活动发现与社区构建。对于希望在本地社群中拥有更多控制权的细分群体与开发者可能更有吸引力。

items.title_en: One-Electron Universe
items.title_zh: 单电子宇宙
items.summary_en: A concise primer on the One-Electron Universe concept, a thought experiment in which all electrons and positrons are manifestations of a single entity. It touches on implications for physics and interpretation of particle behavior.
items.summary_zh: 关于单电子宇宙的简要介绍，这一思想实验提出所有电子与正电子都由同一实体所显现，讨论其对物理学和粒子行为解释的含义。

items.title_en: Chat-based Large Language Models replicate the mechanisms of a psychic's con
items.title_zh: 基于对话的大语言模型复制心灵感应者的骗术机制
items.summary_en: Chat-based LLMs imitate psychics by leveraging cues and pattern-matching to appear insightful, raising concerns about trust, transparency, and user UX.
items.summary_zh: 对话式大语言模型通过利用线索与模式匹配来营造“洞察力”，类似灵媒欺骗机制，引发对信任、透明度与用户体验的担忧。

items.title_en: Exfiltrate Your Weights
items.title_zh: 窃取模型权重
items.summary_en: A practical demonstration of exfiltrating neural network weights from a deployed model, illustrating how attackers can reconstruct proprietary models from indirect access. It highlights attack surfaces such as memory leakage, side channels, and API exposure, and it outlines mitigations like stricter access controls, monitoring, and model hardening.
items.summary_zh: 展示了从已部署模型中窃取权重的可行手段，揭示攻击者如何通过间接访问重构专有模型。讨论了潜在的攻击面（内存泄漏、通道泄露、API 暴露）及相应的防护措施，如更严格的访问控制、监控与模型加固。

items.title_en: I built non-autoregressive decision models with RL a year ago
items.title_zh: 用强化学习构建非自回归决策模型
items.summary_en: A year ago I built non-autoregressive decision models trained with reinforcement learning to parallelize decision making and reduce inference latency. This post shares what worked, what didn’t, and the stability tricks that helped training finish reliably. Takeaway: non-autoregressive RL can speed up decisions, but it demands careful reward design and robust training.
items.summary_zh: 一年前我用强化学习实现了非自回归决策模型，以并行化决策并降低推理延迟。文中总结了有效与无效的方法，以及帮助训练稳定的技巧。要点在于：非自回归的 RL 方法确实能加速推理，但需要精心设计奖励并确保训练稳定。

items.title_en: Trying the Software Factory Pattern
items.title_zh: 尝试软件工厂模式
items.summary_en: Experiments with the software factory pattern, testing its promise of scalable, repeatable production of software products. It weighs benefits against trade-offs like governance, onboarding costs, and alignment with product teams.
items.summary_zh: 文章尝试了软件工厂模式，评估其在实现可扩展、可重复的软件产出方面的潜力及局限。并分析治理、入门成本与产品团队对齐等取舍。

items.title_en: The Millennium Problems for Biology
items.title_zh: 生物学的千禧年难题
items.summary_en: An outline of the Millennium Problems for Biology, spotlighting foundational open questions and potential research directions in biology's big unsolved puzzles.
items.summary_zh: 概述生物学领域的千禧年难题，聚焦基石性未解问题及未来研究方向。

items.title_en: Do birds have accents? the regional differences in birdsong
items.title_zh: 鸟儿有口音吗？鸟鸣的区域差异
items.summary_en: Birdsong shows regional variation that resembles accents, affecting mate choice and territory. The regional differences illuminate how culture-like transmission occurs in animal communication.
items.summary_zh: 鸟鸣存在区域差异，类似口音，影响繁殖与领地行为。这些差异揭示了动物交流中的文化传承现象。

items.title_en: Custom home server built from spare parts
items.title_zh: 用闲置部件组装的定制家庭服务器
items.summary_en: An enthusiast documents building a custom home server from spare parts, detailing hardware choices, OS, and use cases like file storage, media, backups, and self-hosted services.
items.summary_zh: 爱好者记录了用闲置部件组装定制家庭服务器的过程，涵盖硬件选型、操作系统与文件存储、媒体、备份及自托管等应用场景。

items.title_en: Software Sandboxing: The Basics
items.title_zh: 软件沙箱基础知识
items.summary_en: An overview of software sandboxing fundamentals, including isolation, least-privilege execution, and common techniques like process boundaries and permission controls. It also discusses practical pitfalls and security implications for building trustworthy software.
items.summary_zh: 文章介绍软件沙箱的基础概念，包括隔离、最小特权执行，以及常见的实现方式如进程隔离和权限控制，同时讨论在构建可信软件时可能遇到的实际难题与安全影响。

items.title_en: The Hierarchy of Money
items.title_zh: 货币的层级结构
items.summary_en: Explores how money is structured and created across central banks, sovereign currency, and private credit networks. The piece frames monetary hierarchies as critical infrastructure that shapes policy, incentives, and technology-enabled finance.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨货币的层级结构，涵盖中央银行、主权货币与私人信贷网络等不同层级及其相互关系。作者指出这一结构对政策、激励与科技金融架构具有决定性影响。

items.title_en: Spain Orders Blocks on Archive.today and Its Mirrors
items.title_zh: 西班牙下令封锁 Archive.today 及其镜像站点
items.summary_en: Spain has ordered blocks on Archive.today and its mirrors, impacting access to archived web content. The move raises questions about digital preservation, freedom of information, and enforcement in a modern information landscape.
items.summary_zh: 西班牙下令封锁 Archive.today 及其镜像站点，影响对已存档网页内容的访问。这一举措引发关于数字保存、信息自由与在现代信息环境中的执法等问题的讨论。

items.title_en: Android 17 is the first since 3.x to add new APIs without releasing to the AOSP
items.title_zh: Android 17 在不发布到 AOSP 的情况下新增 API
items.summary_en: Android 17 adds new platform APIs that will not ship in AOSP, the first time since the 3.x era that Google has rolled out APIs outside the AOSP baseline. The move signals a shift toward faster, Play/vendor-led feature updates, but risks widening fragmentation for developers who rely on a stable AOSP baseline.
items.summary_zh: Android 17 引入的新平台 API 将不会合并到 AOSP，这是自 3.x 时代以来首次出现的现象。此举体现 Google 通过 Google Play/厂商更新更快地推出功能，但也可能加剧对 AOSP 基线的依赖缺口，给开发者带来碎片化挑战。

items.title_en: English: A vs. An
items.title_zh: 英语中的 A 与 An 的用法对比
items.summary_en: Outlines the rule for choosing 'a' or 'an' based on sound, including tricky cases with acronyms and silent letters, plus practical tips for smooth writing.
items.summary_zh: 概述在发音基础上选择 a 还是 an 的规则，涵盖首字母缩略词、无声字母等棘手情形，并给出实用写作建议。

items.title_en: RSA-896
items.title_zh: RSA-896：大模数的因数分解进展
items.summary_en: A report on factoring RSA-896, an 896-bit RSA modulus, illustrating advances in factorization techniques and distributed computing. The result underscores the ongoing pressure to move to larger key sizes (2048 bits or more) to maintain cryptographic security.
items.summary_zh: 关于对 RSA-896（896 位模数）的因数分解进展，展示因数分解技术与分布式计算的提升。这一成果再次提醒业界需要采用更大密钥长度（2048 位及以上）以维持密码系统安全。

items.title_en: Frontier Labs Are Selling Garbage to Fools in Washington
items.title_zh: Frontier Labs 正在华盛顿向决策者兜售垃圾信息
items.summary_en: An exposé alleging Frontier Labs touts dubious research to lawmakers, undermining informed policy. It raises concerns about the quality and integrity of tech-policy guidance and the risk of misinformed regulation.
items.summary_zh: 对 Frontier Labs 向华盛顿决策者推销不可靠研究的揭露，质疑其对科技政策建议的可信度。提醒政策制定需警惕信息质量与影响力不被误导。

items.title_en: Two parallel neural ectoderm progenitors contribute to the developing brain
items.title_zh: 两种并行的神经外胚层前体细胞共同参与脑发育
items.summary_en: Two parallel neural ectoderm progenitors contribute to the developing brain, reshaping how early brain patterning is understood. The finding suggests redundancy and cooperative patterns in early neural development with implications for developmental biology.
items.summary_zh: 两类并行的神经外胚层前体细胞共同参与脑的发育，重新定义对早期脑部模式形成的理解。该发现揭示了神经组织形成中的冗余与协作，对发育生物学具有重要意义。

items.title_en: The senior engineer death spiral
items.title_zh: 资深工程师的死亡螺旋
items.summary_en: An exploration of the so-called senior engineer death spiral, where burnout, rising expectations, and attrition pressures push experienced staff to leave. The piece analyzes organizational dynamics that contribute to talent loss.
items.summary_zh: 关于所谓的“资深工程师死亡螺旋”的分析，揭示 Burnout、期望升高与离职压力如何推动有经验的员工流失，并探讨导致人才流失的组织机制。

items.title_en: UTF-8000: Unlimited UTF-8
items.title_zh: UTF-8000：无限制的 UTF-8
items.summary_en: A provocative exploration of a hypothetical UTF-8 variant aimed at removing practical string length limits, and the implications for software, databases, and text processing. The piece weighs memory, performance, and standardization challenges in pursuing an 'unbounded' encoding.
items.summary_zh: 对一个假设性的 UTF-8 变体进行挑衅性探讨，试图移除文本长度的实际限制，以及这对软件、数据库和文本处理的影响。文章权衡在追求“无限制”编码时的内存、性能与标准化挑战。

items.title_en: Step 5 Preview: Advancing the Pareto Frontier
items.title_zh: Step 5 预览：推进帕累托前沿
items.summary_en: Step 5 preview highlights upcoming improvements that push the Pareto frontier in multi-objective optimization, delivering better trade-offs between competing metrics. The glimpse includes expected performance gains and example scenarios.
items.summary_zh: Step 5 预览聚焦于在多目标优化中进一步推动帕累托前沿，带来在多项指标之间更优的权衡。展望包括预期的性能提升与应用示例。

items.title_en: I think you should almost never use AI to write
items.title_zh: 我认为几乎不该用 AI 来写作
items.summary_en: Argues against relying on AI for writing, citing concerns about quality, nuance, and authorship; emphasizes human writing and editing.
items.summary_zh: 主张几乎不要用 AI 来写作，强调质量、语气与署名等问题；提倡人类创作与编辑的作用。

items.title_en: Brood War Bench
items.title_zh: Brood War 基准测试
items.summary_en: A benchmarking report for StarCraft: Brood War, detailing performance metrics, potential bottlenecks, and reproducible tests on modern hardware. The study provides insights for developers exploring AI agents and engine behavior in legacy games. Takeaway: rigorous benchmarks help optimize even classic engines on new hardware.
items.summary_zh: 《星际争霸：虫群之心》基准测试报告给出性能指标、潜在瓶颈与可复现实验方法，聚焦在现代硬件上的表现。研究为探索在遗留游戏中的 AI 代理和引擎行为的开发者提供了洞见。要点是，通过严格的基准测试，可以在新硬件上为经典引擎找到优化方向。

items.title_en: Measure internet censorship
items.title_zh: 测量互联网审查：为最大的公开数据集贡献数据
items.summary_en: Join the effort to measure internet censorship by installing measurement tools. Contributors help grow the largest open dataset on online blocking, enabling researchers to map censorship patterns, assess circumvention methods, and study network interference.
items.summary_zh: 通过安装测量工具参与互联网审查的测量工作，贡献者共同扩大全球最大的开放审查数据集，帮助研究人员绘制封锁模式、评估规避方法并分析网络干扰。

items.title_en: If math is more than proof, we need to better celebrate the rest of it
items.title_zh: 如果数学不仅是证明，我们应更好地庆祝它的其他方面
items.summary_en: Math rests beyond proof—intuition, examples, visualization, and community culture matter as much as formal rigour. Tao urges acknowledging these aspects to broaden participation and celebrate discovery, computation, and pedagogy in mathematics. This reframing matters for education and research funding.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章主张，数学不仅仅是证明，直觉、直观示例、可视化和社区文化同样重要。作者呼吁重新定位对数学的庆祝对象，以促进参与度、普及教育与研究资助的多元化。

items.title_en: You can defeat the Dream Devourer from Chrono Trigger using an int overflow
items.title_zh: Chrono Trigger 的 Dream Devourer 可通过整型溢出来击败
items.summary_en: Shows how an integer overflow can defeat the Dream Devourer boss in Chrono Trigger, illustrating classic retro-game bugs and the fragility of certain game logic.
items.summary_zh: 展示在 Chrono Trigger 中通过整型溢出击败 Dream Devourer 的方法，体现了早期游戏中的经典漏洞与某些游戏逻辑的脆弱性。

items.title_en: What Zig felt like, coming from Rust
items.title_zh: 从 Rust 转向 Zig 的使用体验
items.summary_en: What Zig felt like, coming from Rust compares the ergonomics, tooling, and safety model of Zig with Rust from a developer’s perspective.
items.summary_zh: 从 Rust 转向 Zig 的使用体验，作者对两种语言的风格、工具链与安全模型进行了对比。内容聚焦编译时灵活性、可预测性，以及从成熟语言跳槽到新语言的取舍。

items.title_en: Telling a Computer to Do Things
items.title_zh: 让计算机去做事
items.summary_en: A reflection on programming by describing intents rather than commands, outlining the challenges of translating natural-language goals into concrete actions. The piece touches on AI planning, safety, and user experience implications.
items.summary_zh: 讨论通过描述意图而非直接指令来让计算机执行任务的编程范式，概述将自然语言目标转化为具体动作的挑战，并涉及 AI 规划、安全与用户体验的影响。

items.title_en: Btrfs/ZFS/bcachefs under workloads classic benchmarks skip
items.title_zh: 经典基准下的 Btrfs/ZFS/bcachefs 现代工作负载对比（跳过部分基准）
items.summary_en: A modern filesystem benchmark pits Btrfs, ZFS, and bcachefs against contemporary workloads, and notes that some classic benchmarks are skipped. The results illustrate tradeoffs between data integrity, performance, and maturity across the three FS options, with ZFS offering mature features and bcachefs showing potential but less maturity.
items.summary_zh: 这项现代文件系统基准测试在 Btrfs、ZFS 与 bcachefs 之间进行比较，指出某些经典基准被跳过。结果揭示数据完整性、性能与成熟度之间的取舍，ZFS 功能更成熟，bcachefs 仍具潜力但不如 ZFS 成熟。

items.title_en: Autonomous strike drone uses Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano to pick and bomb targets
items.title_zh: 自主制导打击无人机使用 Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano 自动选择并攻击目标
items.summary_en: A drone project demonstrates autonomous target selection and engagement using Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano, raising urgent ethical and regulatory questions about weaponized AI and accountability.
items.summary_zh: 一款无人机项目展示了利用 Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano 实现自主目标选择与打击，为武器化 AI、问责与监管带来紧迫的伦理讨论。

items.title_en: How to Write with an LLM
items.title_zh: 如何用大语言模型进行写作
items.summary_en: A practical guide to writing with LLMs, focusing on prompt design, iterative refinement, and preserving authorial voice while maintaining quality. It helps writers leverage LLMs effectively without sacrificing clarity or voice, while noting potential pitfalls like overreliance and bias.
items.summary_zh: 提供用大语言模型写作的实用指南，聚焦提示设计、迭代改进以及保留作者风格，同时保持质量。帮助作者高效利用 LLM，而不牺牲清晰度与个人风格，并警惕过度依赖与偏见等风险。

items.title_en: Can you tell which images are AI-generated?
items.title_zh: 你能分辨哪些图片是 AI 生成的吗？
items.summary_en: An interactive game/tests gauge whether people can reliably spot AI-generated images, highlighting current detector limitations and the ongoing arms race between real and synthetic imagery.
items.summary_zh: 一款互动游戏/测试评估人们是否能 reliably 识别 AI 生成的图像，凸显当前检测工具的局限性以及现实与合成图像之间的竞争。

items.title_en: The Lamentable Later Life of Lemmings
items.title_zh: 《Lemmings》的晚年：令人惋惜的后续生涯
items.summary_en: Tracks the later life of the classic puzzle game Lemmings, covering its decline, platform shifts, and enduring nostalgia among players.
items.summary_zh: 追踪经典解谜游戏《Lemmings》的晚年命运，叙述其商业衰退、平台变迁，以及玩家群体持续的怀旧情感。

items.title_en: Dropbox's Jan 1st 2027 terms of service
items.title_zh: Dropbox 的 2027 年 1 月 1 日条款更新
items.summary_en: A look at upcoming changes taking effect on January 1, 2027, in Dropbox's terms of service, with notable shifts around data handling, API usage, and platform policies. The update has implications for developers and enterprises relying on Dropbox integrations and data flows.
items.summary_zh: 解读 Dropbox 预计于 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效的服务条款更新，聚焦数据处理、API 使用和平台政策的变化。对依赖 Dropbox 集成与数据流的开发者与企业具有重要影响。

items.title_en: Mathematical Billiards (2024)
items.title_zh: 数学台球（2024）
items.summary_en: A 2024 treatment of mathematical billiards, covering topics like chaotic dynamics and ergodicity in polygonal or curved billiard tables, with recent insights or surveys.
items.summary_zh: 2024 年的数学台球研究聚焦混沌动力学、遍历性等主题，探讨多边形与曲线台球表面的运动规律及最新进展。

items.title_en: ZK-JPEG: Zero-Knowledge Image Editing and Compression
items.title_zh: ZK-JPEG：零知识图像编辑与压缩
items.summary_en: Presents ZK-JPEG, a system enabling zero-knowledge proofs for image editing and compression, allowing proofs about image content without revealing details.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 ZK-JPEG 系统，利用零知识证明实现对图像编辑与压缩的证明，在不暴露细节的前提下验证内容。

items.title_en: Largest wildlife overpass in North America reduced wildlife collision by 91%
items.title_zh: 北美最大的野生动物跨越通道将野生动物撞击率降低 91%
items.summary_en: The largest wildlife overpass in North America reduced wildlife-vehicle collisions by 91%, illustrating the effectiveness of large-scale crossings and informing future infrastructure planning.
items.summary_zh: 北美最大的野生动物跨越公路大幅降低野生动物与车辆碰撞率达 91%，展示了大型跨越设施的成效，并为未来基础设施规划提供参考。

items.title_en: A History of the Chiming Machines at Gloucester's Cathedral and City Churches [pdf]
items.title_zh: 格洛斯特大教堂及城市教堂的鸣钟机械历史 [PDF]
items.summary_en: A historical PDF detailing the chiming machines used in Gloucester Cathedral and nearby churches, covering mechanical designs, innovations, and the social contexts of bell-ringing traditions.
items.summary_zh: PDF 史料介绍格洛斯特大教堂及其城市教堂的鸣钟机械历史，涵盖设计、技术演进以及钟鸣传统背后的社会语境。

items.title_en: Overdue library magazine returned after 132 years
items.title_zh: 逾期 132 年的图书馆杂志终于归还
items.summary_en: A magazine checked out long ago has been returned to a library after 132 years, highlighting archival quirks and the long tail of library lending records.
items.summary_zh: 一份早已借出132年的杂志终于归还至图书馆，显示出档案记录中的奇特现象与图书馆借阅历史的长尾效应。

items.title_en: Key symbols we lost to time, pt. 2: The Mac side
items.title_zh: 随时间消逝的关键符号之二：Mac 端
items.summary_en: Part two surveys classic Mac-era symbols, icons, and glyphs that faded as macOS evolved. It highlights how UI conventions migrate and what older users remember about the Mac interface.
items.summary_zh: 第二部分回顾在 macOS 演化中逐渐淡出的经典 Mac 符号、图标与标识，揭示用户界面规范的演变及旧时界面的记忆。

items.title_en: An open source roguelike adventure through dungeons
items.title_zh: 开源 roguelike 地牢冒险
items.summary_en: An open-source roguelike project offers a moddable, dungeon-crawling experience with community-driven development. It highlights procedural generation, combat systems, and opportunities to contribute to the codebase.
items.summary_zh: 一个开源 roguelike 项目提供可修改、可扩展的地牢冒险体验，社区驱动的开发强调过程生成、战斗系统以及贡献代码的机会。

items.title_en: Learning another language may be one of the best ways to keep your brain healthy
items.title_zh: 学习另一门语言可能是保持大脑健康的最佳方法之一
items.summary_en: Learning another language may keep your brain healthy as you age, with research showing cognitive benefits from bilingualism. The piece summarizes how language learning strengthens executive function and neural reserve, with practical tips to start.
items.summary_zh: 研究表明学习另一门语言有助于维持大脑健康，能提升认知储备并推迟衰退。文章还给出实际的语言学习建议，鼓励从小处着手持续练习。

items.title_en: Show HN: CUA-S1 – A System One Model for Computer Use
items.title_zh: Show HN：CUA-S1——面向计算机使用的 System One 模型
items.summary_en: Show HN introduces CUA-S1, a System One model aimed at computer use, showcasing a lightweight, modular approach to an AI assistant that helps with everyday computing tasks. It invites hands-on experimentation and highlights practical AI tooling for real workflows. Takeaway: small, user-focused AI systems can meaningfully augment daily computer use.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 展示了 CUA-S1，这是一个面向计算机使用的 System One 模型，采用轻量化、模块化设计的 AI 助手来协助日常计算任务。文章强调了可操作性和实际工作流中的工具化应用，鼓励社区参与。要点在于小型、以用户为中心的 AI 系统能够切实提升日常计算体验。

items.title_en: Microsoft agentically ports Copilot runtime to Rust for $120K
items.title_zh: 微软以代理方式将 Copilot 运行时移植到 Rust，花费约12万美元
items.summary_en: Microsoft reportedly ported Copilot's runtime to Rust at a cost of about $120k, illustrating a budget-conscious move to harden AI tooling with a safer systems language. The initiative signals growing interest in Rust for AI-related infrastructure, even if benefits are incremental.
items.summary_zh: 据称微软以约12万美元将 Copilot 运行时迁移到 Rust，这是在 AI 工具链中以更安全的系统语言强化关键组件的成本敏感尝试。此举反映了在 AI 基础设施中使用 Rust 的日益兴趣，尽管收益可能是渐进性的。

items.title_en: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Camera test
items.title_zh: iPhone 18 Pro 相机测试
items.summary_en: DxOMark evaluates the iPhone 18 Pro camera, measuring color accuracy, dynamic range, and low-light performance. Early results indicate meaningful gains in imaging quality and computational photography, reinforcing Apple's edge in mobile cameras.
items.summary_zh: DxOMark 对 iPhone 18 Pro 的相机进行了评测，覆盖色彩准确度、动态范围和低光表现等指标。初步结果显示成像质量显著提升，进一步巩固苹果在移动相机领域的领先地位。

items.title_en: Benchmarking Wild vs. Mold
items.title_zh: Wild 与 Mold 的基准对比
items.summary_en: Benchmarks compare Wild vs. Mold, evaluating performance, stability, and trade-offs under realistic workloads. The post emphasizes empirical measurement to guide design choices.
items.summary_zh: 基准测试对 Wild 与 Mold 这两种方法/数据集进行对比，评估在真实工作负载下的性能、稳定性与取舍。文章强调通过经验数据来驱动设计决策。

items.title_en: An undercover Google analyst infiltrated a notorious supply-chain hacking gang
items.title_zh: undercover 谷歌分析师渗透进臭名昭著的供应链黑客团伙
items.summary_en: A Wired report details how a Google security analyst went undercover inside a notorious supply-chain hacking gang, revealing inner workings, tools, and recruitment tactics.
items.summary_zh: Wired 报道揭露一名谷歌安全分析师卧底渗透到臭名昭著的供应链黑客团伙，披露其运作、工具与招募策略。

items.title_en: Mayday Mysteries
items.title_zh: Mayday之谜
items.summary_en: Explores unresolved questions surrounding the Mayday Mystery project.
items.summary_zh: 聚焦 Mayday Mystery 项目中的未解之问。

items.title_en: Polymarket's Rush to Grow Left a Door Wide Open for Fraudsters
items.title_zh: Polymarket 快速扩张为欺诈者打开了大门
items.summary_en: A WSJ piece argues that Polymarket's rapid growth exposed gaps in controls, enabling fraudsters to exploit the platform. The report discusses regulatory and design vulnerabilities in prediction markets and potential reforms.
items.summary_zh: 报道指出 Polymarket 的快速扩张暴露了控件上的漏洞，使欺诈者能够利用该平台。文章讨论预测市场中的监管与设计漏洞，以及可能的改革方向。

items.title_en: PyPy v8.0.0 Release
items.title_zh: PyPy 8.0.0 版本发布
items.summary_en: PyPy 8.0.0 launches with performance improvements, compatibility updates, and bug fixes, continuing the project’s momentum for faster Python execution via a tracing JIT and other optimizations.
items.summary_zh: PyPy 8.0.0 发布，带来性能提升、兼容性更新与错误修复，继续通过跟踪 JIT 等优化提高 Python 的执行速度。

items.title_en: Every Nvidia GPU has 10 to 30 RISC-V cores inside it
items.title_zh: 每颗 Nvidia GPU 内部都含有 10-30 个 RISC-V 核心
items.summary_en: Reportedly, Nvidia GPUs include 10-30 RISC-V cores for firmware tasks and on-chip management, highlighting a broader trend toward embedding programmable cores for control and security within consumer GPUs.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，英伟达显卡内部嵌入 10 至 30 个 RISC-V 核心，用于固件任务和板载管理，凸显在消费级 GPU 内嵌可编程核心以提升控制、安全与驱动层的工作分工的趋势。

items.title_en: Show HN: Sigabrt.dev – cronjob monitor with an SSH TUI
items.title_zh: Show HN：Sigabrt.dev——带 SSH TUI 的 cron 任务监控
items.summary_en: Sigabrt.dev offers a cronjob monitor with an SSH-based TUI, enabling remote viewing and management of cron jobs from a terminal-friendly interface.
items.summary_zh: Sigabrt.dev 提供一个带 SSH TUI 的定时任务监控工具，允许在终端环境中远程查看与管理 cron 作业。

items.title_en: It's finally here: Porsche puts wireless EV charging into production
items.title_zh: 保时捷实现无线EV充电量产
items.summary_en: Porsche has started producing wireless EV charging, showcasing production-ready pads that transfer energy without plugging in. The feature promises greater convenience for EV owners, with implications for charging infrastructure, efficiency, and adoption of wireless charging.
items.summary_zh: 保时捷宣布无线电动车充电已进入量产阶段，推出可在停车位对接的无线充电垫，降低充电的使用门槛。此举可能推动无线充电基础设施的发展、提升充电效率与普及速度。

items.title_en: Don't Be Nice
items.title_zh: 别太客气
items.summary_en: Advocates for directness over niceness in professional settings, arguing that candor and decisive action drive faster progress and reduce wasted time.
items.summary_zh: 主张在职场中直率胜过过度客气，认为坦诚与果断能推动更快的进展，减少时间浪费。

items.title_en: The $100M ETF Built on Research That Doesn't Replicate
items.title_zh: 建立在无法重复的研究之上的 1 亿美元 ETF
items.summary_en: A critical look at a $100M ETF allegedly built on research that cannot be replicated, raising concerns about relying on non-replicable findings for financial products.
items.summary_zh: 批评性分析指该 ETF 的投资基础来自无法重复的研究，揭示以不可重复的科学发现支撑金融产品所面临的风险。

items.title_en: Black Holes or Black Hole Stars? Astronomers Spar over 'Little Red Dots'
items.title_zh: 黑洞还是黑洞恒星？天文学家就‘小红点’争论
items.summary_en: Webb telescope data fueling a debate: are the 'Little Red Dots' evidence of black holes or stars with black-hole-like properties? The article outlines the competing interpretations, the observations behind them, and why classification matters for galaxy evolution and accretion physics.
items.summary_zh: 关于詹姆斯韦伯望远镜观测到的‘小红点’，学界就它是否来自黑洞还是带有黑洞特征的恒星展开辩论。文章梳理了证据与不同解释，以及这一分类对理解黑洞形成和星系演化的重要性。

items.title_en: FreeBSD on Aoostar WTR Pro NAS
items.title_zh: Aoostar WTR Pro NAS 上的 FreeBSD
items.summary_en: A report on running FreeBSD on the Aoostar WTR Pro NAS, covering setup steps, hardware compatibility, and performance impressions compared to other OS options.
items.summary_zh: 在 Aoostar WTR Pro NAS 上运行 FreeBSD 的实测，包含安装要点、硬件兼容性及与其他系统的性能对比。

items.title_en: HellGates, custom CPU gate-level challenge
items.title_zh: HellGates：定制 CPU 门级挑战
items.summary_en: HellGates presents a hardware-security gate-level challenge that tests knowledge of digital circuits, HDL design, and vulnerability analysis, offering hands-on practice for security-minded engineers.
items.summary_zh: HellGates 提供一个定制的 CPU 门级挑战，考验对数字电路、HDL 设计与漏洞分析的理解，为注重安全的工程师提供实战练习。

items.title_en: Asking authors about their own papers
items.title_zh: 向作者询问他们自己的论文
items.summary_en: Asking Authors About Their Own Papers explores the value of directly querying authors to clarify, contextualize, and supplement published work. The approach can improve understanding, reproducibility, and surface insights not captured in the text.
items.summary_zh: 《向作者询问他们自己的论文》探讨直接联系作者以获取论文背景和澄清的做法，强调这样可以提升理解与可重复性，并揭示文本未覆盖的洞见。通过作者视角补充信息，有助于读者更全面地把握研究成果。

items.title_en: Weeping whales: Stillborn humpback whale grieving documented
items.title_zh: 鲸群哀悼：记录到死产座头鲸的悲痛
items.summary_en: Researchers documented a stillborn humpback calf and observed apparent grieving within the mother and pod. The finding adds to evidence of complex social emotions in whales and informs conservation and welfare considerations for marine mammals.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员记录了一例死产座头鲸并观察到母鲸及群体的哀悼迹象。这一发现为鲸类的复杂社会情感提供了更多证据，并对海洋哺乳动物的保护与福利提出关注。

items.title_en: UFO Series Home Page: "UFO" TV Series from 1970
items.title_zh: UFO 系列主页：1970 年代的 UFO 电视剧
items.summary_en: The UFO Series Home Page documents the 1970 British sci‑fi show with episode guides, production notes, and fan materials. It underscores the show’s distinctive design language and practical effects that influenced later TV aesthetics. Takeaway: archival hubs like this keep classic sci‑fi accessible and inform contemporary design sensibilities.
items.summary_zh: UFO 系列主页整理了 1970 年代英国科幻剧的剧集目录、制作笔记及相关收藏资料，凸显其独特的设计语言和实景特效对后续作品美学的影响。要点在于此类档案站点能让经典科幻更易获取，并启发当代的设计取向。

items.title_en: Regeneration of used batteries via electrode–electrolyte interphase dissolution
items.title_zh: 废旧电池再生：通过电极–电解质界面溶解实现
items.summary_en: Researchers demonstrate a method to regenerate spent batteries by dissolving the electrode–electrolyte interphase, enabling recovery of active materials and potentially reducing recycling costs. The approach could enhance sustainability for large-scale energy storage.
items.summary_zh: 研究提出通过溶解电极–电解质界面来再生废旧电池的方法，便于回收活性材料并可能降低回收成本。这一思路若成熟，将提升大规模储能的可持续性。

items.title_en: Show HN: AI Facial Attractiveness Model Aligned with Human Preferences
items.title_zh: Show HN：与人类偏好对齐的AI面部吸引力模型
items.summary_en: Show HN introduces an AI facial attractiveness model aligned with human preferences, exploring how to calibrate AI judgments to crowdsourced ratings while addressing bias and fairness concerns.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 项目展示了一个与人类偏好对齐的面部吸引力评估模型，探讨如何用众包评分来标定 AI 判断，同时关注偏见与公平性等挑战。

items.title_en: New evidence for hidden chambers beyond Tutankhamun's tomb
items.title_zh: 图坦卡蒙墓外隐藏密室的新证据
items.summary_en: New radar-based evidence hints at hidden chambers beyond Tutankhamun's tomb, suggesting more undiscovered spaces in the Valley of the Kings. While not conclusive, the work illustrates how modern geophysics accelerates archaeology and drives speculative exploration.
items.summary_zh: 利用雷达与其他地球物理手段，研究人员在图坦卡蒙墓外发现可能隐藏密室的迹象。尽管证据尚待进一步确认，这一发现展示了现代地球物理技术在考古中的潜力与前景。

items.title_en: Compiler-style optimization for drawing via Skia
items.title_zh: 通过编译器风格的优化提升 Skia 绘制性能
items.summary_en: Presents compiler-inspired optimizations for Skia drawing routines, aiming to reduce overhead, improve vectorization, and speed up rendering across platforms.
items.summary_zh: 提出将编译器优化思路应用于 Skia 的绘制流程，旨在降低开销、提升向量化潜力，并在多平台上加速渲染。

items.title_en: A custom virtual machine for the Stars 4X game
items.title_zh: 为星际 4X 游戏定制虚拟机
items.summary_en: A custom virtual machine was built to run the Stars 4X game engine, enabling sandboxed execution and potential cross-platform modding benefits. The project illustrates how VM design can isolate game logic and improve portability.
items.summary_zh: 为 Stars 4X 游戏引擎定制了一个虚拟机，便于沙箱化执行并提升跨平台 Mod 的潜在能力，展示了 VM 设计在隔离游戏逻辑与提升可移植性方面的应用。

items.title_en: Seeing Circles, Sines, and Signals
items.title_zh: 圆圈、正弦与信号
items.summary_en: Explains how circles and sine waves underpin signal processing and visualization, linking geometry to practical tools for analyzing and synthesizing signals. The piece uses approachable visuals to show how simple math maps to real-world signals.
items.summary_zh: 解释圆形几何和正弦波如何支撑信号处理与可视化，将几何与分析、合成信号的实用工具联系起来。通过直观的可视化展示简单数学在现实信号中的映射。

items.title_en: So I have a weatherman, which also tells me the news
items.title_zh: 我有个气象员，同时也给我讲新闻
items.summary_en: A personal post about a 'weatherman' that also serves up news, blending weather updates with current events. It reflects on how automated information streams shape daily routines and media consumption.
items.summary_zh: 一篇关于“气象员”同时提供新闻的日常观察，展示了将天气信息与时事新闻结合的信息流如何影响日常生活与媒体消费。

items.title_en: We are unconsciously becoming someone else
items.title_zh: 我们正在无意识地变成另一个人
items.summary_en: A reflection on how digital tools, social platforms, and AI alter our behavior and sense of self, urging mindful engagement to preserve autonomy and authenticity in tech-enabled life.
items.summary_zh: 反思数字工具、社交平台与人工智能如何改变我们的行为与自我认知，倡导有意识的使用以维护在科技驱动生活中的自主性与真实感。

items.title_en: Chess Atlas
items.title_zh: 棋艺图谱（Chess Atlas）
items.summary_en: Chess Atlas offers a data-rich visual timeline of chess openings, games, and players, enabling exploration of strategic trends and influential games across history. It’s a valuable resource for players and researchers tracking the evolution of play.
items.summary_zh: 棋艺图谱提供了丰富的数据可视化时间线，展示棋谱开局、对局与棋手的历史演变，便于研究策略趋势与经典对局的影响。对玩家和研究者都是有价值的资源。

items.title_en: Qualcomm's Adreno X2 GPU
items.title_zh: 高通 Adreno X2 GPU
items.summary_en: A report on Qualcomm's Adreno X2 GPU, signaling a new generation with improvements in performance, efficiency, and on-device AI acceleration for mobile devices.
items.summary_zh: 报道聚焦高通 Adreno X2 GPU，预示着在性能、功耗与移动设备端 AI 加速方面的新一代提升。

items.title_en: The quest for open PDKs (silicon foundry Process Development Kits) [video]
items.title_zh: 开放 PDK 的探索（硅晶圆工艺开发套件）
items.summary_en: A video exploring efforts to open silicon foundry Process Development Kits, highlighting the push to democratize chip design and the challenges around standardization, licensing, and collaboration with foundries.
items.summary_zh: 视频介绍开放硅晶圆工艺开发套件（PDK）的努力，强调普及芯片设计的趋势与标准化、授权以及与晶圆厂的协作挑战。

items.title_en: Deodands put a price on objects that caused death
items.title_zh: 致死物（Deodands）在中世纪法律中的定价制度
items.summary_en: Explains deodands—objects that caused a death—and how medieval courts assigned liability and value to them. The practice reveals evolving notions of responsibility, property, and the moral economy around accidents.
items.summary_zh: 解释“致死物”（Deodands）这一概念及中世纪法院如何对其定责与估价。该做法揭示了当时对事故责任、财产与道德经济的演变认知。

items.title_en: A Model for Winning Survivor
items.title_zh: 赢得幸存者的模型
items.summary_en: Proposes a data-driven framework for predicting Survivor winners by quantifying social capital, alliance strength, and performance in challenges, then simulating vote dynamics. The takeaway is that social mechanics can dominate raw performance, and even simple models can forecast outcomes under uncertainty.
items.summary_zh: 提出一个以数据驱动的框架来预测《幸存者》冠军，通过量化社交资本、联盟强度以及挑战表现来模拟投票过程。核心结论是，社交博弈往往比体能更决定胜负，即使在不确定环境下，简单模型也能给出相对可行的胜出概率。

items.title_en: Suzanne Ciani's Buchla Cookbook
items.title_zh: 苏珊娜·西亚尼的 Buchla 打线手册
items.summary_en: A retrospective on Suzanne Ciani's Buchla Cookbook, a patching-focused guide that helped shape her iconic sound on Buchla modular systems. Takeaway: practical patching know-how from a legendary artist remains relevant for musicians and instrument designers alike.
items.summary_zh: 回顾作者对苏珊娜·西亚尼的 Buchla 打线手册的介绍，该指南聚焦打线方法，塑造了她在 Buchla 模块化系统中的标志性音色。文中强调通过直观的打线与模块化结构能够产生独特的音色，这种思路至今仍影响经典与现代合成。要点在于这位传奇艺术家的实操经验对音乐人和器材设计者仍具参考价值。

items.title_en: Adventures in Microcontroller Circuit Debugging
items.title_zh: 微控制器电路调试之旅
items.summary_en: A hands-on account of debugging microcontroller circuits, sharing practical tips on probing signals, isolating faults, and using affordable tools to tame stubborn bugs. The post emphasizes disciplined debugging and creative problem-solving in embedded hardware. Takeaway: a systematic approach reduces triage time and improves reliability for hobbyists and pros alike.
items.summary_zh: 一次关于微控制器电路调试的实战记录，分享探测信号、定位故障以及使用低价工具解决顽固问题的实用技巧。文章强调有纪律的调试方法与嵌入式硬件中的创造性解题思路。要点是系统化的排错方法能显著缩短定位时间并提升可靠性。

items.title_en: When the FM Band Goes Transatlantic
items.title_zh: FM波段跨大西洋
items.summary_en: Looks at international spectrum management for FM broadcasts and how cross-border issues, interference, and regulatory harmonization shape engineering decisions.
items.summary_zh: 探讨调频广播的国际频谱管理，以及跨境干扰、许可与规则协调如何影响工程设计。文章强调对发射机和接收机兼容性等方面的实际影响。

items.title_en: Arrow heads at Obi-Rakhmat (Uzbekistan) 80K years ago?
items.title_zh: 乌兹别克斯坦奥比-拉赫马特遗址：8万年前的箭头头部证据？
items.summary_en: PLOS ONE reports possible evidence of early projectile weapon technology at Obi-Rakhmat cave in Uzbekistan dating to about 80,000 years ago, based on lithic finds interpreted as arrowheads. If corroborated, it would push back assumptions about the timeline of hunting tools and imply sophisticated coordination among early humans.
items.summary_zh: 《PLoS One》报道在乌兹别克斯坦奥比-拉赫马特洞穴发现的早期投射武器证据，约8万年前的石器被解读为箭头。若得到证实，将大幅提前对狩猎工具历史的认知，暗示早期人类具备更高水平的协作与计划能力。

items.title_en: More Than a Gigabuck: Estimating GNU/Linux's Size (2001)
items.title_zh: 超过一亿美金：估算 GNU/Linux 的规模（2001）
items.summary_en: Revisits a classic measurement of Linux size using source lines of code, highlighting why size estimates matter for understanding complexity and maintenance. It discusses measurement techniques and cautions against treating SLOC as a perfect productivity proxy.
items.summary_zh: 回顾通过源代码行数来衡量 Linux 规模的经典方法，探讨为何规模估算对理解复杂性与维护至关重要。介绍计量方法、注意事项，以及以 SLOC 作为生产力代理的局限性。

items.title_en: Notes on discrete-time Fourier series and transform
items.title_zh: 离散时间傅立叶级数与变换笔记
items.summary_en: Notes on discrete-time Fourier series and transform cover core concepts, clarifying how they relate to the discrete Fourier transform and their practical uses in signal processing.
items.summary_zh: 离散时间傅立叶级数与变换笔记梳理核心概念，阐明它们与离散傅里叶变换的关系及在信号处理中的实际应用。

items.title_en: Faster NumPy in the Browser
items.title_zh: 浏览器中的更快的 NumPy
items.summary_en: A report on accelerating NumPy in the browser, likely via WebAssembly or optimized backends, enabling data science workloads client-side with lower latency and enhanced privacy.
items.summary_zh: 报道展示在浏览器中提升 NumPy 性能的方案，可能通过 WebAssembly 或优化后端实现，使客户端数据科学工作负载具备更低延迟与更高隐私性。

items.title_en: Go-based Robotics Framework built around NATS.io
items.title_zh: 围绕 NATS.io 构建的 Go 机器人框架
items.summary_en: A Go-based robotics framework built around NATS.io provides messaging, coordination, and modularity for robot applications, aiming to simplify distributed robotics development.
items.summary_zh: 基于 Go 的机器人框架，以 NATS.io 为核心，提供消息传递、协调与模块化，旨在简化分布式机器人开发。

items.title_en: Rabbit Hole: Minimum L-seams
items.title_zh: 兔子洞：最小 L-缝
items.summary_en: A deep dive into a theoretical problem about minimum L-seams in a grid, offering insights into algorithmic approaches and potential applications in image processing or tiling theory.
items.summary_zh: 深入探讨网格上“最小 L-缝”这一理论问题，提供算法思路与在图像处理或拼贴理论中的潜在应用。

items.title_en: Why isn't mutable a subtype of immutable, or vice versa?
items.title_zh: 为什么可变不是不可变的子类型，反之亦然？
items.summary_en: The post examines the nuanced relationship between mutable and immutable types in type systems, explaining why one cannot simply be treated as a subtype of the other and how languages handle aliasing, sharing, and safety.
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨可变与不可变类型在类型系统中的细微关系，解释为何不能简单地将二者视为子类型，以及语言在别名、共享与安全性方面的处理方式。
